t: Technical Blueprint for a Minimal AnyWidget Host Environment using FastHTML
s: This article blueprints a minimal host environment for 'anywidget' interactive widgets using the 'FastHTML' web framework. It explores overcoming the complexities of traditional Jupyter-based hosting by leveraging 'FastHTML' and learning from 'Marimo's' native 'AFM' implementation to enable portable widgets in lightweight environments.
sub: Anywidget architecture (Python backend, JS frontend, traitlets sync)
Anywidget Front-End Module (AFM) specification for portability and minimalism
Challenges of custom hosting vs. standard Jupyter ecosystem (kernel, comm, extensions)
FastHTML as a candidate for lightweight hosting (ASGI, Starlette, HTMX)
Marimo as a benchmark for native AFM support
